sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-28 and 2016-12-28, internal automated monitoring identified suspicious transaction activity on card C08299-K1 belonging to customer C08299. Flagged transaction 3581141 in the amount of $30.02 was executed via undocumented. The transaction was initiated from an unrecognized device ( |  |  | ). Cross-account analysis revealed this device fingerprint is concurrently linked to multiple cardholder accounts (C09988-K1, C08106-K1, C11923-K2, C04570-K1, C03042-K1), indicating organized multi-card harvesting or syndicate involvement. Cardholder was contacted and explicitly denied authorizing the charge while confirming physical possession of the card. Historical case memory retrieved relevant precedents (CC-4124, CC-4086) with confirmed fraud typologies. The financial institution has initiated preventive containment including card blocking and heightened monitoring of linked accounts. Total suspicious activity identified amounts to $30.02. This report is filed pursuant to regulatory requirements under Rule R2/R6.
